title: 7-ELEVEN DAY Free SLURPEE or COFFEE with any PURCHASE* On 07.11.26 @ 7/11
body:
Deal: 7-ELEVEN DAY Free SLURPEE or COFFEE with any PURCHASE* On 07.11.26 @ 7/11

[Jesse16246] I was just thinking about this the other day
Just checked my calendar and 7/11 is Saturday
I will miss out this year.
[AsukaST] Note: In store purchases only.
so it excludes fuel.
Any 5 cents item? lol
[Sweetnsour] I interpret it as meaning it excludes app delivery purchases eg via uber eats
[AsukaST] I don't visit 7-11 very often but if their T&C interpretation is similar to Shell Reddy/ flybuys, in store purchases only = exclude fuel purchase.
[nicholasv] Likely fuel would be included - it usually is for these promos
But if not, then buy a paper bag for 15c? 😂 Otherwise a chupa chup
[AsukaST] good idea!👍
I got 3 7-11 servos around me but their price is always higher than Shell and Ampol.
+ they don't have supermarket -4c dockets and no -4c app barcode like AFL app
I never purchase fuel from them.
[nicholasv] I only ever used 7/11 for fuel in the good ole days with unlimited fuel price lock discount. Now I have an EV, so don't think I've visited for a long time 😂
[Rrpnothanx] Afl 4c off stops in a few days 31st OCT 2026
[AsukaST] @Rrpnothanx: That's bad news. Hopefully Shell App -4c stays.
[ATTS] Thanks op gonna buy a slurpee so basically bogof lol
[Ijuiceman] I miss the good old days of bring any cup to fill up with slurpie. My esky is just waiting for this deal to reappear 😝
[unity1] I miss the $1 days https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/46693
[Pluto88] What's the minimum amount of fuel you can buy? I thought 2L but has anyone seen the sign lately?
[nicholasv] When I was a broke uni student like 6 years ago, my car ran out of fuel about 500m from a 7/11. The only container I had in my car was a 1L bottle, but the guy was chill and I filled that up and paid.
So I don't think it is actually an enforced minimum of 2L and they can put through whatever amount. Can't imagine the attendant would tell you to go back and put another litre in 😂
[Pluto88] lol, you just inadvertently found a workaround for a deal 6 years into the future. A true bargain hunter.
